technical_decisions: Đặt API tạo TopoDS_Shape trong backend OCCT qua qymcad-kernel Shape/Kernel; không đặt BRep constructor trong adapter menu.
Mỗi thao tác phải trả Result<T,DomainError>, BRepCheck_Analyzer validity và classify solid/shell/wire; empty/degenerate input không tạo phantom node.
Kiểm tra face names và persistent references theo qymcad-core names/ref; rebuild và Undo/Redo không đổi topology ngoài chủ đích.
Kiểm tra axis direction, angular extent, seam và trường hợp profile cắt trục; so sánh area/volume với trường hợp giải tích.

input.purpose: revolve profiles around axis / rail constraints

positive.setup: Create the geometry and select the inputs required by: revolve profiles around axis / rail constraints
positive.expected: Exact BRep generated from profile/rail; compare input orientation, bounding range, open/closed topology, stable face names, and invalid self-intersecting input refusal.

negative.setup: Use degenerate wire, null shape, zero/negative radius/height or impossible tolerance appropriate to Revolve Profile And Rail Revolve
negative.expected: Explicit domain error; document IDs, BRep cache, selection and undo journal unchanged

invariants: No success with only tessellation when an exact BRep is required
Do not infer success from an unrun test

golden_test_design.input: closed rectangle in r-z plane r=5..7,z=0..10; revolve 360° about z
golden_test_design.positive_assertions: closed annular solid V=π(49-25)×10 mm³, seam and face orientation valid
golden_test_design.negative_assertions: axis zero vector, invalid profile intersects axis, angle out of allowed domain
